key_points: 30% decline over 30 days driven by a guidance reset, creating short‑term bearish pressure.
Q3 2026 operating margin more than doubled, indicating strong underlying profitability and execution.
Institutional ETFs added $125.8 million of Intel stock, showing accumulating sentiment despite price drop.
Analysts maintain a buy rating with a 133% upside target, suggesting a bullish thesis remains intact.
Broader chip sector sell‑off appears driven by Nvidia’s rally and may be temporary, supporting a medium‑term recovery.
